lines.text: Don't let her near the bridge.
[quiet, unsettled] He played it for me. My voice. Words I've never said.
[tired and scared, but holding steady] Kabir, it's me. Mira. You don't know me yet... but you will. Please don't get on the six-forty train.
lines.show: Kabir, it's me. Mira. You don't know me yet… but you will. Please don't get on the 6:40 train.

lines.text: [stunned, quietly] I got that three nights ago. I thought it was a prank. Until today.
[slowly realizing] His messages were saving me. Mine were saving him.
[soft] Somewhere out there... we were trying to save each other.
[a small smile] So in the future... we know each other.
[shy, warm] He said it like it was a good thing.
[low] Then he played the newest one.
[crying, barely holding on] Kabir. Friday night. Don't let her near the bridge.
[firm, gentle] Then I'm not leaving your side. Not for a minute.
[whisper] That's what scared me. Because in seven days... he doesn't make it.
